description: A phone lies on the bed near a coiled white charging cable, with a pillow propped up against the headboard. The right hand reaches to the phone and lifts it into a right-hand object while the left hand brings the cable tip in as a left-hand object, then the left hand aligns and plugs the connector into the phone so it becomes a two-hand object briefly; after the connection is made, the right hand lowers the phone back onto the bed while the cable trails away and the left hand releases.
